name: EPM_Elevated Command and Scripting Interpreter
xql_query:
// ============================================================
// Rule: EPM_Elevated Command and Scripting Interpreter
// Vendor: BeyondTrust
// Objective:
// Detect activity associated with EPM_Elevated Command and Scripting Interpreter.
// Severity: SEV_030_MEDIUM
// Category: EXECUTION
// ============================================================
// MITRE ATT&CK:
// Tactic: TA0002 - Execution
// Technique: T1059 - Command and Scripting Interpreter

config case_sensitive = false

| dataset = beyondtrust_epm_raw

| filter is_epm_event = true
| filter is_epm_privilege_event = true
| filter epm_event_code in (100, 112)

| alter
    epm_process_command_line = json_extract_scalar(process, "$.command_line"),
    epm_parent_process_name = json_extract_scalar(process, "$.parent.name"),
    epm_parent_process_path = json_extract_scalar(process, "$.parent.executable"),
    epm_hosted_file_path = json_extract_scalar(process, "$.HostedFile.path"),
    epm_hosted_file_sha256 = json_extract_scalar(process, "$.HostedFile.hash.sha256"),
    process_name_lc = lowercase(process_name)

| filter process_name_lc in (
    "cmd.exe",
    "python.exe",
    "pythonw.exe",
    "bash.exe",
    "sh.exe",
    "wscript.exe",
    "cscript.exe",
    "mshta.exe"
)

| fields
    _time,
    epm_event_code,
    event_type,
    event_message,
    risk_level,
    endpoint_name,
    endpoint_id,
    endpoint_ip,
    epm_username,
    user_domain,
    process_name,
    process_path,
    epm_process_command_line,
    epm_parent_process_name,
    epm_parent_process_path,
    epm_hosted_file_path,
    epm_hosted_file_sha256
description: Detectar interpreters e shells que exigiram elevação ou receberam direitos administrativos, excluindo PowerShell para evitar duplicidade. Filtra eventos 100/112 e nomes exatos de interpreters: cmd, Python, bash/sh, Windows Script Host e mshta.
alert_description: Foi identificada atividade de privilégio do BeyondTrust EPM envolvendo o interpreter $process_name no endpoint $endpoint_name , executado pelo usuário $epm_username com o comando $epm_process_command_line . O SOC deve validar o script, o processo pai e a finalidade da execução.
